a: Editing a pin in the token layers drops its `description` and `scope`
Ramp and scale editors read their parameters from the last derivation, not the draft, when the draft does not derive
Unpinning a swatch removes every anchor sharing its name
"Copy as tokens" writes swatch names into JSON unescaped
b: Anchor lightness field's 0.3–0.97 bounds (and 0.01/1° steps) don't cover the lightness a pinned hex really has
Unpinning a grid swatch removes every anchor with that name, not just the one pinned
Stored constraints keep any string for an enum field such as `order`
`fitted` undercounts the size it trims, so a saved history can end up over budget
